title: A probability sample

feedback.message: The three possible pairs are not equally likely here; follow the procedure.

hints: List the pairs this procedure can produce.
The coin gives {A, B} or {A, C}, each with chance 1/2.
solution: Every sample contains A, so $\{B, C\}$ has chance 0, and $\{A, C\}$ happens when the coin picks C: chance 1/2. Because these chances can be computed in advance, it is a probability sample, even though the chances differ.
